name: Sun & Moon Family Pokémon Card Game

releases.name: Sun & Moon Family Pokémon Card Game

description.text: Family Pokémon Card Game, a set released on 15 March 2019 for families: three 60-card decks, led by Raichu-GX, Charizard-GX and Mewtwo-GX, so a whole family could play, with a playmat, a coin, damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, two GX markers, three deck bands to keep the decks apart, two battle guides, a beginner's guide and a card box.
